updates.body: We are investigating the issue for the listed services.

We have identified an upstream GitHub service disruption affecting review publication and pull request creation in Codex. Follow [GitHub’s status page](https://www.githubstatus.com/ "GitHub’s status page") for updates. We expect these workflows to recover as GitHub restores service.

We are working on implementing a mitigation.
